title: Standard version v1
description: config/standard/versions/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F1c): a version of the development standard that is not one of the docs/padrao/v<N>/ folders yet. A folder version is read where it is; its rules are those its padrao.json lists.

contains.description: catalog: every rule of config/standard/rules/ that is not replaced (derived, never listed).
